name: Parallel Paragraph Reader
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Select Open left or Open right to open the source at the paragraph's recorded start line.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Parallel Paragraph Reader is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with your writing.
